# aap_eda_credential (Data Source)

Get credential datasource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "aap_eda_credential" "example" {
  id = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Credential ID.

### Read-Only

- `credential_type_id` (Number) ID of the credential type.
- `description` (String) Credential description.
- `inputs` (String) Specify a string by using using `jsonencode()` to encode similar data as as string in state. Specify alphabetically when using the second method.
- `inputs_as_object` (Dynamic) Credential inputs as object. This is the same data as `inputs` but in object format.
- `name` (String) Credential name.
- `organization_id` (Number) ID of organization which owns this credential.
